svg.title: Williams tandem paper glider cutting and folding pattern
svg.metadata: Open Flight contributors, tandem-1. Based on Archibald Williams, Things To Make (1918 edition), figure 128, Model B. Editable geometry: CERN-OHL-W-2.0, https://spdx.org/licenses/CERN-OHL-W-2.0.html. Original markings: CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/.
svg.desc: The left end is the nose. Cut the solid outline. Four dotted lines cross the nose for weighting folds. The long dashed center line forms the keel, and the dash-dot lines mark the four wing roots.
